q24.

```
web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:178          — useCreateMemo() mutation hook; mutationFn calls memoServiceClient.createMemo({ memo }) (line 183)
web/src/connect.ts:197                       — memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport) (Connect-Web client)
proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go:409  — MemoServiceHandler.CreateMemo (generated RPC surface; message types in proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.go:469, CreateMemoRequest)
server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go:306 — ConnectServiceHandler.CreateMemo → delegates to APIV1Service.CreateMemo
server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70      — APIV1Service.CreateMemo (auth, build store.Memo, calls s.Store.CreateMemo at line 115)
store/memo.go:109                            — Store.CreateMemo (UID validation, then s.driver.CreateMemo)
store/driver.go:29                           — Driver.CreateMemo (interface boundary over dialects)
store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16                   — sqlite DB.CreateMemo; builds "INSERT INTO `memo` (...) VALUES (...) RETURNING ..." at line 41
```

Notes:
- The dialect leg has three implementations behind `store.Driver`: `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:16`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:16`. SQLite shown above as the one dialect driver.
- The RPC contract is also exposed over grpc (`proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service_grpc.pb.go:314`, `MemoServiceServer.CreateMemo`); the web client goes through the Connect handler path.
- The frontend→handler hop is a name-inferred bridge (dynamic Connect client member), confirmed by reading the callsite `memoServiceClient.createMemo` at `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:183` and the client construction in `web/src/connect.ts:197` — not a statically resolved call edge.
